datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0S THRU BZT52C75S Surface Mount Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The BZT52C6V8S row specifies VZ min 6.4 V, nominal 6.8 V, and max 7.2 V at IZT = 5 mA; the nominal value is recorded as the typical breakdown point.
The p. 3 Zener Characteristics plot is a family plot; the 6.8 V trace was read directly without interpolation between datasheet curves.
The capacitance plot on p. 3 is a generic family characteristic and does not unambiguously identify a BZT52C6V8S trace, so capacitance is omitted.
Reverse recovery time is not published in the supplied datasheet.
Dynamic impedance is tabulated as ZZT = 15 ohm at IZT = 5 mA and ZZK = 80 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, but the strict extraction schema has no impedance fields.
omission_reason: Capacitance and reverse recovery are not represented for this part: the supplied datasheet gives only an unassigned family capacitance plot and publishes no reverse-recovery time.
